clock_hz_semantics: Default for the original attempts. Convert raw ticks using the selected image's config.json clock_hz; explicitly labelled clock-fallback builds can differ.
event_pair_semantics: first_tick at even slot, latest_tick at odd slot; event-valid bits required
notes: Use the exact selected attempt's verified application clock when converting ticks; fallback images must not be reported as 250 MHz.
Input HBM base is a mapped Coyote virtual address, not a raw physical HBM address.
Initialize the GPU header, mailbox and mapping before arm. Match raw length to the GPU header.
An invalid trial requires controlled DMA drain/reset before reuse; result availability alone does not prove successful storage.
HBM GPU inference readiness: bytes_forwarded equals raw_bytes and chunks_completed equals ceil(raw_bytes/65536).
Network GPU inference readiness: gpu_words equals ceil(raw_bytes/64), gpu_requests equals ceil(raw_bytes/65536), and gpu_completions equals gpu_requests.
Perform external-DMA visibility validation after readiness and before R06 inference.
Network sender credits follow freed_chunks, not NIC acknowledgements.
Main latency origins differ: accepted arm for HBM; first accepted application payload for network.
